##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 09 November 2026 at 9:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

A deep low pressure remains to the southwest of the British Isles over the next few days, gradually filling.


##Wind##

Easterly 2 to 4, increasing 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south of the area this afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight, occasionally moderate in the south this afternoon.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Easterly mainly 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the far south for a time tomorrow morning, decreasing East or Northeast 3 or 4 Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
